name: repeatedly pick the point that makes the smallest turn from the current edge
mechanism: start at an extreme point; among all remaining points choose the one such that every other point lies to one side of the line from the current point to it (the smallest angular turn), step to it, and repeat until the start is reached

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gift wrapping algorithm or Jarvis march' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry:

requires: an orientation test on three points
fails_when: cost is points times hull size; slow when most points are on the hull
instances: Gift wrapping algorithm or Jarvis march
